title: Track bulletin / track warrant
description: Railroad movement authority paperwork on a neutral form of a simulated railroad (not a copy of any rulebook form). Variant 'bulletin': a typed track bulletin listing restrictions in effect (speed restrictions, track out of service, protect workers and machines between mileposts, signals out of service) with the dispatcher, OK time and crew copy lines. Variant 'warrant': the crew's hand-copied track warrant, numbered boxes with the applicable ones checked and the blanks filled in by hand. Item 'type' selects the box (warrant) or the label (bulletin). FRA may be named. One Letter page.

number.description: Track bulletin or track warrant number

issuedTo.description: Train, engine or employee in charge the authority is addressed to

atLocation.description: Where the recipient is when it is issued

items.description: Restrictions (bulletin) or checked boxes (warrant). Bulletin types: speed_restriction, track_out_of_service, protect_workers, signal_out_of_service, other. Warrant types: void, proceed, work_between, not_in_effect_until, expires, hold_main, clear_main, do_not_foul, restricted_speed, bulletins_in_effect, other.
One restriction or one warrant box

type.description: Kind of restriction or warrant box

limits.description: Where it applies, as written (mileposts, control points, track)

from.description: From point (warrant blanks: proceed, work between, restricted speed)

restriction.description: The restriction or the value written in the box (speed, times, number voided, instructions)
examples: 10 MPH passenger and freight. Track geometry defect.

okTime.description: OK time given by the dispatcher after the repeat

copiedBy.description: Employee who copied and repeated it

relievedAt.description: Time and point the authority was released / limits reported clear (blank while in effect)

notes.description: General notice or crew notes printed under the items
examples: Dispatching system on manual operation. Bulletins issued by radio and repeated in full.
